items.title: Kering stock reacts to China luxury slowdown as investors weigh Gucci recovery
items.summary: German financial outlet reports Kering shares fell 3.6% on August 24 after fresh reporting on weaker Chinese luxury demand. China remains the swing factor for Gucci's improving-but-still-negative comparable sales; Kering continues to trade at a discount to European luxury peers pending clearer evidence of sustained Gucci recovery.

items.title: Gucci seemingly on cusp of turnaround after H1 2026 results
items.summary: Trade press analysis of Kering's H1 2026 results notes Gucci revenue fell 9% reported (5% comparable) to EUR2.757bn, but the quarterly trajectory improved from an 8% like-for-like Q1 decline to a 2% Q2 decline; piece credits CEO Francesca Bellettini's ReconKering actions and flags the 2027 L'Oreal beauty licence as a further lever, while cautioning the turnaround is not yet complete.

items.title: Gucci's better-than-expected Q2 sales send Kering shares surging
items.summary: Bloomberg reports Gucci's Q2 comparable sales fell only 2% versus an expected 3.3% decline, improving across all regions, driving Kering shares up as much as 16.9% in Paris trading; piece attributes the beat partly to US demand for new handbag styles and notes analysts still flag that pricing had earlier drawn 'greedflation' criticism, which Bellettini's team has since revised.

items.title: France's Kering posts H1 growth as Gucci shows retail momentum
items.summary: Smaller outlet recaps Kering's H1 2026 print: group revenue EUR7.22bn (+1% comparable), operating income EUR921m at 12.8% margin; notes Saint Laurent and Bottega Veneta outperformed in North America and Western Europe while Gucci's own regional Europe breakdown was not detailed, underscoring Gucci still lags healthier sister brands in its home region.

items.title: Is Gucci closing its Avenue Montaigne boutique in Paris?
items.summary: Italian trade outlet reports Gucci's 1,500sqm Avenue Montaigne flagship lease expires at year-end with no renewal steps taken by Gucci or Kering; a rent dispute with the property's family owners (since 1910) is in French courts, while Gucci is separately preparing a new flagship at Rue Saint-Honore/Rue Castiglione, framing this as retail-network rationalization rather than a Paris retreat.

items.title: Milan prosecutors widen luxury-supply-chain labor exploitation probe
items.summary: Italian outlet reports Milan's Procura, led by PM Paolo Storari, has expanded its labor-exploitation investigation (undeclared work, unsafe machinery, degrading housing at subcontractor workshops in Pero/Marnate) to nine more houses; article recalls the December 2025 first wave that had already named Gucci among 13 brands asked to hand over supply-chain compliance documents, keeping reputational and regulatory risk live for Gucci's Italian manufacturing base.

items.title: Gucci becomes title partner of Alpine's Formula 1 team from 2027
items.summary: Trade press confirms Gucci will become title partner of the Renault-owned Alpine F1 team starting the 2027 season under a new 'Gucci Racing' platform, with the car repainted in Gucci livery; framed as a brand-visibility and 'performance, precision, discipline' positioning play rather than a direct sales lever, and one of the marketing bets underpinning the turnaround narrative.

items.title: nss magazine TikTok covers Gucci's La Famiglia SS26 campaign reveal
items.summary: Italian fashion-media TikTok account (Milan-based, EU audience) posted coverage of Demna's 'La Famiglia' SS26 campaign teaser under #lafamiglia #gucci #demna; account's comparable prior Gucci posts have run in the 130-170K-like range, but exact view/like/comment counts for this specific video could not be confirmed via public fetch, so engagement fields are left null rather than estimated.
